newsitem.title: UK: Protean up nine pct after H1 results.
newsitem.headline: Protean up nine pct after H1 results.

text.p: Shares in laboratory equipment supplier Protean Plc jumped nine percent on Thursday despite a fall in pre-tax profits and a moderate statement on the full-year outlook.
By 1142 GMT the stock was up 13p at 157-1/2p.
The group announced a fall in first-half pre-tax profits to 2.5 million stg, after an exceptional charge of 1.3 million stg, from 3.9 million a year ago.
Protean, which also specialises in water purification, issued a profit warning in September which immediately pushed the share price down to 170p from 240p.

Group Chairman Peter Ryan said: "The results for the first half of the year are disappointing, with a very poor financial outcome from our German operation overshadowing an otherwise satisfactory performance from the rest of the group.
"I believe that we have now taken the necessary action to improve the situation in Germany."
Ryan said the group's German operations were not expected to make a significant contribution in the current year. "Elsewhere the group is sound and order books are ahead of budget," he said.
